# The Faktion ticket bar

The single source of truth for what a good ticket looks like here.

- [`intake.md`](intake.md) - turning a ramble into requirements. Read when the input is conversational rather than a written spec.
- [`smells.md`](smells.md) - functional vagueness. Read while grilling.

Write only what the requester actually described.

See [`write-bug`](../write-bug/SKILL.md) for bugs.
